newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end down on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end down on profit-taking.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended lower on Wednesday on profit-taking but select blue-chip buying wiped out some of the early losses near close, dealers said.

"The market is likely to move gradually up with some technical adjustments on the way," a dealer at KAB Securities said, adding that the highly positive gainer-to-loser ratio showed that major buying interest was still there.

The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) index fell 5.24 points, or 0.32 percent, to end at 1,642.76 after dropping to 1,634.07 in early trade. Gainers led losers 250 to 48. Turnover fell to 57.19 million shares from 87.23 in the previous session.
